About the Role:

Care Delivery is the infrastructure that powers how Maven members access care and how our providers deliver it. Every program we run across maternity, fertility, menopause, and pediatrics, depends on it. It's where clinical workflows, provider tooling, and the systems that make care measurable, billable, and scalable at Maven's scale all come together.

We're looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform: the EHR and clinical tooling, provider workflows, messaging, and the data and billing infrastructure that turn Maven's care model into something reliable and scalable. You'll own defined capabilities within the platform and drive them from problem to shipped, in close partnership with engineering, clinical, design, and operations. It's a high-leverage seat. What you build here touches every program Maven offers.

You'll report to the Group Product Manager, Care Delivery, and work closely with our providers, as well as Clinical Product, Member Experience, Operations, and the Data and AI Platform teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own specific Care Delivery capabilities end-to-end, provider workflows, clinical documentation, messaging, scheduling and matching, or quality and billing infrastructure, from problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Make crisp, well-reasoned product decisions, especially where clinical accuracy and provider experience are both at stake.
  • Use AI hands-on to move faster, prototyping with AI tools to test ideas and pressure-test flows before committing engineering time, and identify and build AI-powered capabilities into the care delivery platform where they genuinely improve the provider or member experience.
  • Partner daily with engineering and design to ship reliable platform capabilities, and with clinical and operations partners so that what you build works for real providers and members.
  • Translate regulatory and quality requirements, like HEDIS measures and clinical coding, into clean product experiences that add value without adding friction.
  • Instrument what you ship, watch how it performs, and iterate. Bring data to every decision.
  • Build platform primitives, reusable capabilities that serve many programs, rather than one-off features.
  • Bring a point of view on how AI can improve care delivery workflows, and put it to work in how you build.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally with some time in healthcare tech or another complex, regulated, or operations-heavy domain.
  • A strong executor: you take ambiguous problems, break them down, and ship, without needing everything defined for you.
  • Solid data instincts: you define the right metrics, work with real datasets, and communicate findings clearly to both clinical and commercial audiences.
  • Comfort with technical and clinical complexity: you can hold your own in an engineering sprint and a clinical review, and you're eager to learn the domain fast (FHIR, interoperability, EHR workflows).
  • Genuine care for providers and members: the people using what you build show up in your decisions.
  • Clear, direct communication and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • Fluency with AI and a genuine desire to build with it: you understand how modern AI models work well enough to know where they're reliable and where they aren't, you reach for AI tools to prototype and think, and you're excited to ship AI-powered features rather than just talk about them.
  • Bonus: experience with EHR or EMR systems, clinical workflows, healthcare interoperability, or provider-facing tools.

The base salary range for this role is 155,000-185,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £94,000 - £118,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

title: Junior Performance Marketer (Remote - Romania)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Execution and Scaling Support:

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

Creative & Funnel Contribution:

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Spain | Remote
description:

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €85,000 - €107,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

title: Junior Performance Marketer (Remote - Ukraine)
description:

And we’re only just getting started!

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Senior Sales Engineer, Nordics
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our products and services.

  • Technical expertise - Demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients

  • Customer engagement - Meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Pre-Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect in the cybersecurity domain

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative

  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Swedish

Travel Required

This role is fully remote and may require up to 50% of travel to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €160,000 - €190,000 OTE 70/30 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Researcher
description:
Please know that this is an Expression of Interest. We treat EOIs differently than typical job ads. They're a less involved way for us to see who is interested in a position.

  • The default is you will not hear from us. We may not review all applications, and we will only contact people whose background fits our needs.
  • We're not able to reply to questions about this posting or about the status of your submission.

Researcher at The Future of Life Foundation

About FLF

The Future of Life Foundation (FLF) is distinct but affiliated with the Future of Life Institute. Our shared mission is to steer transformative technology towards benefiting life and away from extreme large-scale risks.

FLF focuses primarily on identifying gaps or relatively neglected efforts to fulfilling this mission, and marshalling resources to fill those gaps. To date this has involved establishing new organisations, generating new teams within established organisations, incubating fellows or nascent projects, and communicating our visions more widely in publications and workshops.

We expect our most significant focus to remain on the risks posed by transformative AI, and governance mechanisms needed to ensure that AI is beneficial to humanity. Other areas of work could include biosecurity, nuclear technology, other risks to humanity’s existence or fulfillment of its potential, and the development of tools, institutions, and communities that support these efforts.

A major (but not exclusive) focus so far has been AI tools for collective human agency: taking advantage of (and steering) new prospects from AI building blocks to differentially enable human societal decision-making during this crucial period. You can see more of our thinking on our website.

About the Role

To maintain and improve these activities, FLF needs situational awareness, insight, and generative vision: this is where researchers come in. In short, researchers work on sourcing and developing ambitious ideas to build a flourishing future, grounded in realistic scenarios for AI and other technological development. Together with the team, researchers apply their expertise, capacity for insight, network and skills to shaping these projects and nascent organisations into their best form.

You’ll be joining a team ‘in motion’, with some tentative worldview and strategy ‘bets’ already in play, but we remain open to the possibility that further strategy research updates or expands these. We want open-minded researchers who are happy to be challenged and to challenge in turn.

Besides high-level worldview and strategy, several roadmaps in motion and yet to be developed will benefit from insight and exceptional critique. Your work will often involve uncovering the best versions of a prospect as well as highlighting challenges or essential desiderata and considerations that we haven’t mapped out yet.

Researchers generally benefit from excellent generalist thinking, but there are several areas of specialisation which we anticipate being especially valuable:

  • AI safety (technical, governance, strategy)

  • AI generally (LMs and beyond) and enterprise-scale software

  • Political science, human (social) behaviour

  • Systems theory, cybernetics, and systems safety

  • Economics, especially macroeconomics of automation and labour displacement

  • Law, especially corporate law, contracting, liability, and tort law

Activities

The following are primary responsibilities of the research function at FLF: any researcher will be working or co-working on these activities with a majority of their time. Where noted, ‘wider team support’ refers to crossover activities shared with other functions, especially likely to be cross-function collaborative. These run roughly in lifecycle order, from noticing what matters, to designing an intervention, to helping launch and shape it. Researchers stay involved across that arc.

Foresight and worldview

  • Maintain and improve FLF’s situational awareness and scenario foresight, especially regarding AI and its interactions with technology and society

  • Notice and surface potentially impactful trends or scenarios; articulate important ‘arenas’ for FLF to pay attention to

  • Collaborate with partners and contacts outside of FLF on priorities and potential collaborations

Envisioning and design

  • Anticipate a) civilisational vulnerabilities and disruptions and b) opportunities for positive civilisational change, especially regarding AI

  • Collect seed ideas/visions (or innovate afresh) for types of intervention to progress toward positive change on vulnerabilities or opportunities

  • Investigate early visions for feasibility, core challenges, and downside risks

  • (With wider team support) research existing or prior related efforts and synthesise learnings, considering what might have changed, or what new insight or advantage FLF has (or could have)

  • (With wider team support) develop (socio)technological designs and roadmaps for tech, institutions, organisations, or initiatives bringing FLF’s ambitions into fruition

  • Estimate relative promise of proposals at varying stages of readiness: from early gestures to more defined roadmaps

Organization Formation, Advising, and Award Review

  • Work alongside FLF’s project development staff and founders to take promising roadmaps from concept to launch: sharpening the thesis, defining early milestones, and shaping the initial team and strategy

  • Act as a research advisor to nascent projects and organisations as they form, bringing domain expertise, critique, and connections

  • Evaluate projects in motion: surface where they are drifting from their theory of change or missing key considerations, and inform decisions to continue, expand, or redirect

Outward communication

  • (With wider team support) deliver workshops, presentations, and reports to share vision and roadmaps with partners or publicly

  • Contribute to recruitment pipeline for promising roadmaps: direct search, RFPs, job descriptions, reviewing, interviewing

  • Interact with existing or prospective fellows/founders to inspire, brainstorm, refine etc.

Tooling

  • (With wider team support) contribute to tooling, especially AI workflows, to support and compound all of the above activities

Likely Qualifications

  • Demonstrated willingness and ability to seriously consider a range of scenarios and risks from AI

  • Proven ability to perform high-quality research, preferably in AI, existential risk, or a relevant domain (political science, systems safety, economics, law, …)

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Passion for helping to further AI safety

Additional Possible Qualifications

  • Penchant for high-quality writing (informative, understandable, appealing/approachable); perhaps an existing relevant platform or network

  • Familiarity with government and/or national security and adjacent thinktanks or suppliers

  • Experience developing and distributing software and AI applications

  • Experience with the founding of new organizations

  • Significant research achievement demonstrated by publications in top-tier conferences and journals coupled with years of pertinent academic experience

  • A track-record of impactful grantmaking

  • History of performing technical research beyond AI safety

  • A particularly strong technical background

Logistics

You will be an employee of the Future of Life Foundation, or our affiliated organization, the Future of Life Institute. Each are 501(c)(3) research non-profits.

  • Compensation and Benefits: Compensation is competitive with Bay Area tech roles (excluding equity), plus full benefits.

  • Location: The team is currently geographically distributed through North America and Western Europe, and we can welcome applicants from a wide range of locations. We should be able to sponsor US visas (without going through the visa lottery) for those who need them. We meet in person several times per year in varied locations.

Miscellaneous

We are committed to diversity and equal opportunity in all aspects of our hiring process. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We welcome and encourage all qualified candidates to apply for our open positions.

As a Senior CRA at PSI, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, integrity, and compliance of clinical trials across various therapeutic indications. You will act as the main point of communication between clinical trial sites and project teams, building strong relationships with investigators and site staff while ensuring the rights, safety, and well-being of trial participants.

Remote role in Milano, Italy

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing, conducting, and reporting on all types of monitoring visits, including site selection, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits
  • Ensuring compliance with study protocols, ICH-GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with investigators and site staff
  • Monitoring patient recruitment, study timelines, and site performance
  • Performing source data verification, following up on data queries, and managing site-level risks
  • Overseeing investigational product accountability, trial supplies, and essential study documentation
  • Maintaining Investigator Site Files (ISF) and supporting Trial Master File (TMF) reconciliation
  • Delivering study-specific training to investigators and site staff
  • Supporting regulatory submissions, audit preparation, and resolution of audit findings
  • Providing guidance and mentoring to less experienced Clinical Research Associates
  • Degree in Life Sciences or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Minimum 3 years of experience of independent on-site monitoring experience in Italy, ideally across multiple clinical trials
  • Experience conducting all types of monitoring visits in Phase I, II, and/or III clinical trials
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience supporting oncology studies is an advantage
  • Good knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and clinical trial regulations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international team
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to clinical trial sites

This is a great opportunity for you to further develop your skills, widen your therapeutic area experience, and become an expert in clinical research.

We are the company that cares – for our staff, our clients, our partners, and the quality of the work we do. A dynamic, global company founded in 1995, we bring together more than 3,000 driven, dedicated, and passionate individuals. We work on the frontline of medical science, changing lives and bringing new medicines to those who need them.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Senior Data Analyst owns data quality for our Supplier data as part of our new Data Enablement function. You'll evaluate whether the output of our data engine is correct, complete, and trustworthy, and own the analytical work of linking our registry backbone to supplementary data sources.

Data Enablement sits alongside Data Engineering: you'll partner closely with its Director and the data and ETL engineers on technical execution, while also working with Product and other cross-functional teams to share insights and surface new opportunities in the data.

What You Will Do

Data Quality Ownership

  • Own the analytical data-quality work for our Supplier data: profiling, sampling, issue quantification, and recommendations to engineering.
  • Drive source linking across our registry backbone and supplementary sources (such as S&P Capital IQ, GLEIF, and SAM), and help define a systematic approach to resolving conflicts between sources.
  • Define and monitor quality dimensions (completeness, freshness, accuracy), and help build the automated quality gates that don't exist today.
  • Prioritize quality effort toward the subset of entities customers actually interact with most.

Cross-Functional Insight & Opportunity-Finding

  • Partner with the Director of Data Engineering and the data and ETL engineers to translate quality findings into technical fixes and prioritized work.
  • Work with Product and other cross-functional teams to share data insights and help identify new opportunities in the data, beyond quality alone.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give visibility into data health across the platform.
  • Bring a customer's-eye view to quality prioritization and to product improvements like TrustIQ, informed by direct experience with how customers actually use the data.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • Strong SQL and BigQuery (or equivalent) data-analysis skills, with hands-on data-quality and profiling experience across multiple external data sources.
  • Comfortable working across both data warehouse and data lake environments (Snowflake), with hands-on experience using analysis and dashboarding tools built on top of them (such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode) to surface and communicate findings.
  • Familiarity with dbt or similar transformation tools is an asset, not a requirement.
  • Customer-facing or implementation background that supports quality prioritization from a user's perspective.
  • Comfort partnering across engineering, product, and other cross-functional teams to share findings and influence priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with legal-entity or supplier data sources (OpenCorporates, S&P Capital IQ, GLEIF, SAM, or similar registries).
  • Working knowledge of master data management and entity/source-linking challenges (tax IDs, DUNS, name and address matching).
  • Experience building or defining automated data-quality gates or monitoring.

Where You Fit In

You'll sit within Data Enablement, working closely with the Director of Data Engineering, Data Architect and the data and ETL engineers on technical execution, and with Product and other cross-functional teams on sharing insights and finding new opportunities in the data. For now, you'll report directly to the CTO while Data Enablement's leadership structure is built out.

We do no accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment/search firms.

AI Use Policy: The use of artificial intelligence tools during your interview is strictly prohibited. This includes, but is not limited to, AI chatbots, real-time answer generators, transcription-based assistants, and any other software that generates or suggests responses.Any detected use of AI during the interview will result in immediate disqualification and removal from consideration for this position.

Supplier.io is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Supplier.io is unable to sponsor work visas (e.g., H-1B, TN, OPT, etc.) for US positions. Candidates must meet in-country work authorization requirements.

title: Sales Closer (Healthcare)
description:
Job Title: Sales Closer (Healthcare)

Position type: Part-Time (with full-time opportunity)

Work hours: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM Pacific Time

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Job code: CP-BH

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client, a U.S.-based medical aesthetics practice, is looking for a Sales Closer to drive patient engagement, convert inquiries into booked appointments, reactivate inactive leads, and close treatment package sales.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in sales, enjoys building relationships, and is motivated by measurable results. You'll play a key role in growing the practice by connecting with prospective and existing patients, following up on sales opportunities, and creating a welcoming, professional experience.

The ideal candidate is a proven sales closer with strong appointment-setting skills, a warm and confident phone presence, and the persistence to turn leads into paying customers.

Experience in medical spas, aesthetics, or healthcare is highly preferred, but strong sales professionals from other industries are welcome to apply. Spanish fluency is also highly preferred but not required.

The position starts at 20 hours per week, with the goal of transitioning to full-time as the practice grows. You'll receive direct training, sales scripts, and guidance to help you succeed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Follow-Up, Appointment Conversion & Sales Closing (Top Priority)

  • Follow up with new inquiries and convert prospective patients into booked appointments.
  • Proactively reconnect with inactive patients, lost leads, and previous inquiries to generate new sales opportunities.
  • Conduct outbound calls and consistent follow-ups to encourage appointment bookings and treatment purchases.
  • Explain available treatments and packages using approved information and sales guidelines.
  • Confidently ask for the sale and help close treatment or package purchases.
  • Send secure payment links, monitor payment status, and follow up on outstanding deposits or purchases.
  • Maintain a warm, persuasive, and professional approach throughout the sales process.
  • Track lead conversions, appointment bookings, and sales performance against agreed goals.

2. Phone Coverage & Patient Communication (Top Priority)

  • Answer incoming and overflow calls using RingCentral.
  • Respond to patient inquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Provide accurate general information about services, appointments, and next steps.
  • Build rapport with prospective and existing patients through friendly, confident communication.
  • Direct clinical or other specialized inquiries to the appropriate staff members.
  • Document important call details and ensure timely follow-ups.

3. CRM Management & Administrative Support (Top Priority)

  • Maintain accurate patient and lead information in Aesthetic Record CRM.
  • Update lead statuses, document calls, and track follow-up activities.
  • Schedule appointments and maintain an organized practice calendar.
  • Monitor appointment readiness and coordinate necessary follow-ups.
  • Organize sales pipelines and identify leads requiring additional outreach.
  • Provide general administrative and back-office support as needed.

Sales & Lead Management

You'll work with an established database of prospective and existing patients, including:

  • Approximately 5–10 new leads per day, depending on marketing activity.
  • An existing database of approximately 1,000 contacts for follow-up and reactivation.
  • Leads generated through marketing campaigns, social media, email, and other practice channels.

You will not be responsible for sourcing or purchasing lead lists. The client provides leads through Aesthetic Record.

Outbound outreach and lead reactivation will be especially important during the initial part-time arrangement. Lead volumes may increase as marketing campaigns expand, and prompt responses to new leads will be a key priority.

Tools & Platforms

  • Aesthetic Record CRM: Lead management, patient records, appointment scheduling, and follow-up tracking. Training will be provided.
  • RingCentral: Incoming and outgoing calls, patient communication, and sales outreach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently converting qualified inquiries into booked appointments.
  • Proactively reactivating inactive leads and generating treatment sales.
  • Following through on sales opportunities, payment links, and outstanding deposits.
  • Maintaining professional, welcoming communication with every patient.
  • Keeping CRM records, lead statuses, and follow-up activities accurate and updated.
  • Meeting agreed appointment conversion and sales performance goals.
  • Managing responsibilities independently and adapting to the practice's evolving needs.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven sales experience with demonstrated closing ability.
  • Hands-on experience with appointment setting, lead follow-up, and sales conversion.
  • Experience conducting outbound calls, proactive outreach, and cold calling.
  • Ability to reactivate inactive leads and confidently pursue sales opportunities.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong phone etiquette with a friendly, warm, persuasive, and professional approach.
  • Confidence explaining products or services, overcoming objections, and asking for the sale.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when maintaining CRM records and tracking follow-ups.
  • Ability to manage multiple leads, prioritize opportunities, and work toward performance targets.
  • Willingness to learn the client's treatments, packages, sales scripts, and established processes.
  • Familiarity with customer confidentiality and willingness to follow HIPAA requirements.
  • Proactive, persistent, self-motivated, reliable, and comfortable working independently.
  • Willingness to transition from part-time to full-time as business needs grow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical spas, aesthetics, healthcare sales, or a related industry.
  • Familiarity with Aesthetic Record CRM or similar medical spa/aesthetics platforms.
  • Experience selling treatments, service packages, memberships, or other high-value offerings.
  • Experience managing large lead databases and reactivation campaigns.
  • Experience handling patient inquiries, appointment scheduling, and front-desk support.
  • Spanish-English bilingual proficiency is highly preferred but not required.

Candidates with strong sales closing experience from other industries are encouraged to apply. Proven sales ability and excellent English communication are more important than industry-specific experience or bilingual proficiency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A Confident Sales Closer: Comfortable asking for the sale, overcoming objections, and turning inquiries into paying customers.
  • Persistent & Results-Driven: Motivated to follow up consistently and convert inactive leads into new opportunities.
  • Warm & Personable: Creates a welcoming experience while building trust and rapport with prospective patients.
  • Proactive & Independent: Takes ownership of the sales pipeline and identifies opportunities without constant supervision.
  • Highly Organized: Maintains accurate CRM records, schedules, and follow-up activities.
  • Adaptable & Coachable: Learns new systems and services quickly and applies feedback effectively.
  • Reliable & Accountable: Consistently follows through on commitments and works toward agreed performance goals.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have relevant sales experience, including appointment setting and closing.
  • Must be comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls.
  • Must be available Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
  • Must be open to potentially increasing working hours to full-time.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

title: WC Claim Representative II
description:
SUMMARY

This is the intermediate level of the claim handler career path. Handles moderate to difficult claims. Exercises progressively more discretion in the determination of compensability of claims. Considers many factors in the determination claim reserves. Negotiates and settles claims within given authority.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  1. Verifies workers’ compensation coverage of employers and injured employees.
  2. Determines compensability under workers’ compensation by thorough investigation of the claim.
  3. Determines causal relationship between the reported injury and the incident to ensure appropriate payment of benefits.
  4. Facilitates return to work for the injured employee.
  5. Establishes timely and appropriate reserves based on the profile of the claim within given authority based on anticipated financial exposure.
  6. Documents specifics of claims with potential for subrogation recovery, including amount of potential recovery monies.
  7. Manages medical bills for non-indemnity and indemnity claims directly associated with the claimed injury.Approves payment based on knowledge of the treatment plan and medical support showing relationship of treatment to the injury.
  8. Concludes and closes files following resolution of claims to meet internal performance standards while complying with state legislation to avoid penalties and manage expenses.
  9. Negotiates settlements with attorneys or injured parties within given authority at the earliest possible point to bring cases to final disposition.
  10. Works closely with manager on complex files or files above settlement/reserve authority.
  11. Manages outside vendors to ensure cost containment efforts.
  12. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with all internal and external customers.
  13. Stays abreast of changes in workers’ compensation statutes, case law and rehabilitation efforts/advancements in order to accurately interpret and apply relevant laws.
  14. Administers complex claims and catastrophic exposures within authority, including claims from dedicated large accounts.
  15. Exercises independent judgment to settle cases prior to mediation or litigation.
  16. Actively participates in agent/client relationship management.

Experience of handling claims in multiple jurisdictions preferred.Bilingual skills preferred.
